name: Kynaios
description: A Theran human who, with Tiro, led the people against the immortal archon Agnomakhos and became a guardian of the polis of Meletis.

timeline.summary: Kynaios and Tiro rise together to challenge the tyrant Agnomakhos and rally the people.
timeline.quote: Kynaios and Tiro, joined by their love for one another and for freedom, rose to challenge him.

timeline.summary: Meletis is founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire with Kynaios and Tiro as guardians.
timeline.quote: The polis of Meletis was founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire as a beacon of freedom and enlightenment
